messages:
release-bot: Heads-up: new release-train policy for large model artifact rollouts (>2GB). Effective immediately for any model or quant file >2GB: pre-warm in staging, a coordinated off-peak merge window, and a post-deploy KV/cache validation run are required. See the short checklist below and the migration window at the end of the message.

jules: Can you clarify why >2GB? Is this about S3 bandwidth or instance OOMs?

samir: TL;DR it's both. Large weight uploads spike network egress + cause long cold-starts on GPU pools. We saw a handful of noisy restarts last week during a simultaneous weight push + autoscaler spin-up. This policy prevents that.

ops-oncall: Required steps for any >2GB artifact: 1) open a release ticket in the release-tracker with tag `large-artifact`, 2) schedule a pre-warm job in staging that runs the full model init (script below), 3) pick the off-peak merge slot (see calendar), 4) run post-deploy cache-validation. Approval = SRE lead + release manager.

leo: Pre-warm script (use in staging):
```bash
#!/bin/bash
MODEL_PATH=$1
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python -c "from loader import Model; m=Model('$MODEL_PATH'); m.init(); m.warm_kv_cache(seed=42)"
```
Run time ~5-15m depending on size. Capture logs and attach to the ticket.

product-led: Is there a temporary exception process if a customer P0 needs a fast rollout?

samir: Yes: open a `large-artifact-exempt` PR against the release ticket, include risk assessment, fallback runner, and explicit rollback time window. Exemptions are scoped to single-region and require a postmortem within 48h.

jules: How does this affect Dedicated/Private customers?

ops-oncall: Dedicated: same rules but use the Dedicated pre-warm runner (internal hostgroup `prewarm-dedicated`). Private: advise customers to follow the pre-warm guide in the ops-docs; we'll help coordinate if they sign the assist playbook.

samir: Additional housekeeping: 1) tagging artifacts with `size:<MB>` in the manifest helps the release-bot detect them automatically; 2) avoid simultaneous model+quant merges in the same window.

release-bot: Auto-detection snippet for CI (add to your pipeline):
```yaml
steps:
  - name: artifact-check
    run: |
      size=$(stat -c%s "$ARTIFACT_FILE")
      mb=$((size/1024/1024))
      if [ "$mb" -gt 2000 ]; then echo "::warning file=PIPELINE::Large artifact detected ($mb MB)"; fi
```
This will annotate PRs.

leo: Ops calendar slots for off-peak merges (UTC): Mon-Fri 02:00-04:00, Sat-Sun 06:00-09:00. Book via the release calendar and ping @ops-oncall once reserved.

product-led: Will update the public rollout expectations doc and notify GA customers.

ops-oncall: Enforcement: starting next Monday we'll block merges with `large-artifact` label that have no pre-warm logs attached. If you need help retrofitting pipelines, ping ops and we'll pair.

jules: Thanks—I'll run a test pre-warm for the quant pipeline and post results.

samir: Closing note: this is to keep our Dedicated and Hosted customers stable during heavy model churn. If anyone has automation ideas to shorten the pre-warm, share in #eng-automation. :gear: :rocket:

release-bot: Policy effective: 2024-09-02. Follow-ups: we will publish a short FAQ and a pre-warm self-test harness by end of next sprint.
